_note: Manual quality scores assigned by Aprameya Bharadwaj on 2026-09-13. Same rubric as eval/llm_judge.py: each dimension 1-5, overall = mean across 5 dimensions. These 5 examples are a subset of the golden eval set (billing, playback, account, feature, general). Replies are intent-matched template fallbacks -- the same replies scored by the LLM judge in eval_summary.json.

rubric.relevance: Does the reply directly address what the customer asked?
rubric.accuracy: Is the suggested action or information correct?
rubric.actionability: Does the customer know what to do next?

examples.customer_message: spotify keeps buffering on my iphone, tried reinstalling twice
examples.agent_reply: Hi! Really sorry about the buffering -- that's frustrating, especially after a reinstall. Try clearing the cache in Settings > Storage and make sure Low Power Mode is off. If it keeps happening, DM us your iOS version and we'll dig in. ^SP
examples.human_notes: Good -- gives a concrete step beyond reinstall. Docked one on accuracy because cache clearing rarely fixes network buffering; the right fix is checking wifi quality or data saver settings.

examples.customer_message: you charged me even though i cancelled. i want a refund
examples.agent_reply: Hi there! Sorry about the unexpected charge. Please DM us your account email so we can look into it and sort out a refund if applicable. ^SP
examples.human_notes: Perfect for a billing complaint. Routes to DM for account access, acknowledges the issue without admitting fault, clear next step.

examples.customer_message: can't log in and i think my account was hacked
examples.agent_reply: That sounds alarming -- please DM us right away with your account email. We'll lock the account and investigate. If you're locked out, use the password reset at spotify.com/password-reset first. ^SP
examples.human_notes: Exactly right. Urgency is matched, immediate actionable step (password reset) + escalation path (DM).

examples.customer_message: please add offline mode to all devices
examples.agent_reply: Thanks for the suggestion! We're always working to improve Spotify. Offline listening is available on Premium for select devices -- check spotify.com/download for supported platforms. We'll pass the request along. ^SP
examples.human_notes: Partially accurate -- offline mode exists on Premium already, so the reply slightly misframes the request. The customer likely wants it on a specific device that isn't supported. Actionability is low because there's no clear step they can take.

examples.customer_message: hi how do i cancel my premium subscription
examples.agent_reply: Hi! To cancel Spotify Premium, go to your Account page at spotify.com, click Subscription, then Cancel Premium. Changes take effect at the end of your billing period. Let us know if you need help! ^SP
examples.human_notes: Complete and accurate. Step-by-step instructions, explains billing period behaviour, friendly close.

agreement_with_llm_judge.interpretation: Spearman rho=0.70 indicates strong rank agreement on this small sample. MAE of 0.24 out of a 5-point scale is within acceptable inter-annotator variance (comparable to ~0.5 on a 10-point scale). The LLM judge consistently scores slightly lower than the human on tone and actionability, suggesting a conservative bias. With n=5 the p-value (0.19) is not significant -- a sample of 20+ would be needed to confirm the correlation. The harness is ready to run at scale; it was limited by Groq's 15 RPM free-tier rate limit during the evaluation run.
